decision.explanation: The question asks when the *Freaky Friday* musical began its performances. Three distinct dates are provided across the sources: D1S1 states October 4, 2016 at the Signature Theatre; D2S1 states January 1, 2018 at the same venue; and D1S5 states January 31, 2017 at the La Jolla Playhouse. These are separate events (different venues and times) and thus represent distinct valid answers. There is no evidence to prioritize one over the others, so all three are retained.
